description: A shell script for performance testing the core.fsmonitor feature in Git, including setup, environment configuration, and various test suites for different fsmonitor configurations.

methods.name: trace_start
methods.description: Initializes trace logging if GIT_PERF_7519_TRACE is set, creating a directory and setting environment variables for trace output.

methods.name: trace_stop
methods.description: Stops trace logging by unsetting GIT_TRACE2_PERF if tracing was enabled.

methods.name: touch_files
methods.description: Creates a specified number of empty files in a directory.

methods.name: setup_for_fsmonitor_hook
methods.description: Configures the fsmonitor hook, choosing between Watchman and an empty script, and updates Git configuration accordingly.

methods.name: test_perf_w_drop_caches
methods.description: Runs performance tests with optional cache dropping based on environment variable.

methods.name: test_fsmonitor_suite
methods.description: Runs a series of performance tests for different git status and diff commands under various fsmonitor configurations.
